metadata.boundary: Builds a private git-archive export of the pinned Grok Build source with cargo --locked, then executes its official prompts, native subagents, tools, permissions, compaction, worktree behavior, and headless JSON protocol.
metadata.accounting: Terminal JSON totals remain lower bounds for compaction, side-model, unfinished-child, and some nested calls.
metadata.build_identity: Manifest preflight records the source export, Git, Cargo, rustc, and executable identities. Bit reproducibility additionally requires every optional SHA-256 pin and still does not pin the hosted model or service policy.
metadata.workspace_owner: The adapter copies a caller-supplied seed, strips inherited Git administration, creates a fresh standalone baseline, and exports a bounded binary patch before deleting the trial; do not add a local environment block.
